vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines a hierarchy of mathematical vector classes (Vector2, Vector3, Vector4) built upon the gl-matrix library. Its primary role is to provide a strongly typed, object-oriented interface over raw vector data, ensuring safe manipulation of positional and directional data. It implements serialization and deserialization methods to seamlessly integrate with JSON persistence layers, making it a core data model element.
